decisions.reason: The plug-ins sit squarely in the firm's core geospatial integration business, have their own page, and as a product line are easier to refine than withdraw.

The building digital-twin service fits the firm's strategic move toward enterprise-integrated geospatial solutions, but as a lightly presented service offer it still carries moderate commercial uncertainty.

This authentication and identity delegation offer overlaps with the firm's stronger identity/access positioning and is only lightly marketed, so consolidation into the broader portfolio is more likely than continued standalone offering.
The identity and access service was explicitly launched as enabling seamless GeoIT integration and appears to be the clearer strategic anchor for this part of the portfolio.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training strengths, though as a newly packaged service it could still be folded into broader advisory offerings if demand stays limited.
